text: I received a gift voucher for a free blood test, like a health checkup, so I went to try it. First, they pricked my finger and examined it under a microscope. They said my blood was highly acidic and looked like I worked near a factory. Then, after waiting about an hour for the results, someone who wasn't a doctor or medical professional came to explain and show me the results. ✳️ My uric acid level was 9.5. I thought, "Wow, I've been controlling my diet, why is it so high?" (10 months ago it was 8.5). ✳️ My kidney function test (eGFR) was 80. They said I was in stage 1, but after researching, I found out it's actually stage 2. I was shocked because this disease is very serious; it doesn't get better, it only slows down the progression (10 months ago it was 98). I've been taking good care of myself. They then gave examples of other clients who had their blood levels returned to normal at this clinic. Initially, the cost was almost 200,000 baht, but after negotiation, it was reduced to 80,000 baht. I really wanted to do it because I'm afraid of dying, but another part of me thought, "I've been taking good care of myself." I was stressed for 10 days and then decided to get tested at Bangkok Hospital Pattaya. ✳️It turned out my uric acid was only 8.1, and my kidney function (eGFR) was 119. In short, my kidneys are still healthy and my uric acid has decreased. So I told my doctor about this, and he said there might be something wrong. I thought it was very strange that my kidney function and uric acid levels were so bad, and luckily they had a way to help me, which would require a large sum of money, but they had a promotion offering a discount of almost 50%.
